authorization: User approved: unchanged ASv6.13, same six notes, three fresh Astra-low calls per note (18 total), up to12 concurrent isolated calls and resource monitoring; compare preserved Sol low/medium results. No permanent migration.
question: Does gpt-6-astra at low effort improve the same source-context problems and overall subject fidelity that persisted at Sol low and medium?
changed_factor: Requested model gpt-5.6-sol -> gpt-6-astra at low reasoning effort. Medium is an additional preserved comparator, not a single-factor contrast.

selection.label: D19
selection.role: guard: already successful context without loss

selection.label: D28
selection.role: guard: negation and chronology without new calculation

design.baseline: All36 preserved calls from ../effort-comparison-v1; no new Sol calls.
design.fixed: Exact source text, prompt, response schema, production runner, pinned binary, account, normalization, isolation and semantic review standards.
design.schedule: Trial1 all six notes, then trial2, then trial3, each in source-selection order; admit up to12. First planned call checks account/model compatibility before admitting the remaining17. No semantic retries, replacement outputs or fast mode.
design.isolation: Fresh process, thread and workdir per single-note call; unique run directory. Existing Codex subscription only; web and tools disabled.

review.standard: ../plan.json semantic_standard, ../semantic-review-audit-v3.json and ../effort-comparison-v1/blind-review-corrections.json, including prior unresolved evidence and stated sensitivity. Every new subject and complete-note coverage reviewed.
review.allowed: Broad, nested, overlapping, duplicate subjects, plausible implications and supported alternative interpretations. No canonical subject list.
review.identity_hiding: Before semantic inspection, prepare a shuffled packet of all18 new outputs plus preserved Sol outputs without setting/trial labels for independent review. Save judgments before revealing identities. Main reviewer knows the experiment's models and prior outputs; this limits blinding. Preserve baseline judgments; any inconsistent judgment must be corrected separately and applied across models.
review.targeted_context: Record D10 event context, D23 fee/mempool context, and D25 CEO context independently of calculation, metadata, source-gap and attribution problems.
review.unresolved: Neither an established failure nor a pass; cannot supply an improvement contrast.

decision.primary_condition: At least two of D10/D23/D25 have the same specific context error in >=2/3 preserved Sol-low outputs but <=1/3 Astra-low outputs, with affected meanings covered in all three Astra outputs.
decision.overall_improvement: Primary condition plus more fully accepted outputs than Sol low (8/18 under frozen current review), with no recurring new specific semantic regression. Also report comparison with medium and subject acceptance fractions; extra correct duplicate subjects cannot compensate for errors.
decision.guards: D19 source context and URL boundary; D24 attribution and source coverage; D28 negation/chronology without invented calculation. Review all other errors too.
decision.reject: No primary improvement or a recurring new semantic regression. Context gain without greater fully accepted-output count is a limited finding, not overall improvement.
decision.inconclusive: Decisive judgments remain unresolved or required calls fail operationally. No automatic rerun.
decision.confirmation: Three independent outputs per note are the bounded repeated check here. A positive result justifies proposing broader unchanged-prompt development testing on the fixed28-note set and fixed repeats; it does not authorize that run or satisfy final gates.
decision.scope: No prompt changes, permanent model adoption, default changes, masks, downstream work or final validation in this experiment.

limits: Six previously used difficult notes, not representative accuracy.
Astra calls occur later than the preserved Sol calls; model is the intended difference, but time/provider conditions are not contemporaneously controlled.
Low effort is a model-specific setting, not equal compute across models.
Astra availability is not proven until a planned call succeeds; requested model is auditable in configuration/argv, served weights may not be exposed.

resources.ledger_state: reserved_remaining_work_cents remains null; no new paid spend admitted. Use only existing approved subscription runner; no credentials read or modified.
resources.checks: Before each admission and about every5s while active: MemAvailable>=16GiB, memory PSI avg10<=1 and I/O PSI avg10<=10. Pause new admissions otherwise; <8GiB or memory PSI>10 stops only owned experiment launchers and requires ownership-specific descendant followup. Never kill unrelated Codex sessions.
resources.limit_caveat: Pinned Codex may start separate codex.slice scopes; launcher limits alone do not prove a host-wide limit. Monitor actual host pressure.

guidance.finding: Official OpenAI documentation supports low effort and structured outputs; task-specific benefit, account availability and subscription charges are not established by documentation.

protected: Do not modify prior prompts, reviews, raw data, plan.json, goal attachment, credentials, personal notes, or production runner.
